context: Follow-up required by docs/internal/adr/adr-benchmark-methodology-provisional-policy.md (which states an amendment edits the ADR and the public methodology page together) after PR #4486 amended Answers 1 and 4. description:
## Problem
`docs/internal/adr/adr-benchmark-methodology-provisional-policy.md` was amended in core PR #4486 so Answer 1 points to `_project/decisions/vendor-publication-terms-2026-11-19.md` (D1-D6) and Answer 4 reflects the all-source perf-smoke spread, 5 ms flat floor, and 15 ms cap in `scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py`. The live methodology page at `https://benchbox.dev/docs/concepts/benchmark-methodology.html` (owned by `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site`) still says 'the page asserts nothing about what any vendor's terms allow' and omits the clamped perf-smoke floor details.

## Change
Update the benchmark methodology page in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` so Answer 1 and Answer 4 match the accepted core ADR, and open a PR against `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site`.
